verdict.rationale: Hosting llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for a SaaS platform with developer documentation, so the axis applies. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developers.google.com/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack describes documentation built for agent consumption. The existing developer guides and the Discovery document are conventional API references, and the ADK add-on item describes building agents, not docs for agents to read.
